items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Then, in later years, I played with the Padre Roy with Pinky.

ctx.x: I've heard many, many musicians say that, and I don't think that the general public understood what he was doing. Very tough, man. Tops.

It's a funny thing, Dick. I got started playing drums. I'm doing vacation. I got a little job in the field, you see. Delivery boy, bundle boy. And Leo was my driver, but I didn't know he played drums, man. So, I used to call him Jazzy Leo all the time. I wonder why they call him that. When he come out to cash, turning the cash in. A little fat Irishman. He beat his hand on the table, fast. I said, man. So, one day, it was a pace drum in the truck, see. Truck like a pace, fancy. No, no pound truck that they have…
